performed_via_github_app.description:
Codecov provides highly integrated tools to group, merge, archive and compare coverage reports. Whether your team is comparing changes in a pull request or reviewing a single commit, Codecov will improve the code review workflow and quality.

## Code coverage done right.®

1. Upload coverage reports from your CI builds.
2. Codecov merges all builds and languages into one beautiful coherent report.
3. Get commit statuses, pull request comments and coverage overlay via our browser extension.

When Codecov merges your uploads it keeps track of the CI provider (inc. build details) and user specified context, e.g. `#unittest` ~ `#smoketest` or `#oldcode` ~ `#newcode`. You can track the `#unittest` coverage independently of other groups. [Learn more here](
http://docs.codecov.io/docs/flags)

Through **Codecov's Browser Extension** reports overlay directly in GitHub UI to assist in code review in [Chrome](https://chrome.google.com/webstore/detail/codecov/gedikamndpbemklijjkncpnolildpbgo) or Firefox (https://addons.mozilla.org/en-US/firefox/addon/codecov/)

*Highly detailed* **pull request comments** and *customizable* **commit statuses** will improve your team's workflow and code coverage incrementally.

**File backed configuration** all through the `codecov.yml`. 

## FAQ
- Do you **merge multiple uploads** to the same commit? **Yes**
- Do you **support multiple languages** in the same project? **Yes**
- Can you **group coverage reports** by project and/or test type? **Yes**
- How does **pricing** work? Only paid users can view reports and post statuses/comments.

### Review Guide

This PR adds the _live typing_ feature to hazel which supplements Hazel's static type checking with dynamic type inference provided by live probes. It works by automatically observing terms which have statically incomplete types using live probes, and incorporating that data back into the static type checker. This work is downstream of https://github.com/hazelgrove/hazel/pull/1858 which just extends the _type probe_ projector with the ability to view the _live types_ but does not extend the error marks generated from the inferred types. The feature is gated behind a settings toggle.

#### Suggested Order
- [src/language/statics/LiveTyping.re](https://github.com/hazelgrove/hazel/pull/1988/changes#diff-41d8d4305d2eb767e88c7bf7ce5c5547606b59099ee9e2dedc820f5a1ac1218e) - Provides the core data structure that needs to be produced by the evaluator to be provided by live typing
  - This includes the collection of sampled values by Id as well as instantiated types for System-F style polymorphism
- [src/language/statics/Statics.re](https://github.com/hazelgrove/hazel/pull/1988/changes#diff-78d299b3e7a12a38d178508ca26481e42e3b8bbb5d0478c396e4452c44df2e6c) - Extends the static type checker with the aforementioned live typing data structures
  - This should perform static type checking as ordinary while falling back to the live typing information in the case that a static type is not fully known using LiveTyping.refine_typ_with_dynamics
- [test/evaluator/Test_Evaluator_LiveTyping.re](https://github.com/hazelgrove/hazel/pull/1988/changes?w=1#diff-17155de2d8548f9de68c625059f0a70c96a9736c40391b6cf9d3b0ef41692d8a) - tests exhibiting the types of live typing errors that should show up 
- [src/language/dynamics/state/EvaluatorState.re](https://github.com/hazelgrove/hazel/pull/1988/changes#diff-6f594d4d237e47256eeeb7c863d7880f44826308d910b1d52d49d3c37b66f3d4) - Extends the evaluator state with the abililty to capture type instantiations
  - The type instantiations are used to allow for live typing to be compared against the join of all instantiations in a polymorphic function 
- [src/haz3lcore/ProblemCollection.re](https://github.com/hazelgrove/hazel/pull/1988/changes#diff-c6b5b3ad80ff6591a8cdc2affef4ab34348b12a8e038e77650135105f49c1b81) - adds live typing errors to the problem sidebar
- [src/web/app/inspector/CursorInspector.re](https://github.com/hazelgrove/hazel/pull/1988/changes?w=1#diff-8bed94fcc687e96fc3fb088f1b59001a30879f2f43681e5d23a48074685de07c) - Cursor inspector is changed to thread live typing errors to the bottom bar prioritizing static errors first and adding styling for live typing errors.
- [src/web/app/editors/code/CodeWithStatics.re](https://github.com/hazelgrove/hazel/pull/1988/changes#diff-eb11abe6a7f6001c1b56c4cc1ec9920d32e0c018eddeb610d28b38154b756511) - The CodeWithStatics logic also has to cache/update the live typing information from dynamics now. This is also where live typing errors and code decorations are added to the state to be rendered.
- [src/web/app/editors/code/CodeViewable.re](https://github.com/hazelgrove/hazel/pull/1988/changes#diff-6f594d4d237e47256eeeb7c863d7880f44826308d910b1d52d49d3c37b66f3d4) - the code viewing function has been extended to allow for a function projecting html classes for certain terms (specified by id) so that we can mark part of types as "dynamic"

#### Semi-related changes
- [src/language/term/Grammar.re](https://github.com/hazelgrove/hazel/pull/1988/changes#diff-21e4d78e8f3ba603efde8c18d0b5bad9ec8ac220f0d00d887d3d203ed4cf98e3) - moves the type and name for the `Fun` factory builder to optional arguments
